$comment: `run.json` in a run directory of run format 1.

DroppedRoute.description:
A route the preflight dropped: not in its agent's model list, or its probe did not
complete. `kinds`: the kinds whose chain held it.

model.description: empty: the coding agent's default model
model.title: Model

reason.description: not in its coding agent's model list, or how its probe ended (`rate limited`, `timeout: ...`: no answer within the longest `timeout_s` of the kinds whose chain held it, ...)
reason.title: Reason

kinds.description: the kinds whose chain held it
kinds.title: Kinds

DroppedRoute.title: DroppedRoute

KeptKind.description: A kind with no route left, run as configured all the same (`substitute`), and why.
KeptKind.title: KeptKind

PreflightRecord.description:
What a preflight did, as `run.json` records it (`preflight`): its policy, the routes
it dropped, and, for each kind left with no route, its substitution, the kind kept
as configured, or the kind that stopped the run (`stopped`).

stopped.description: the kinds with no route left that stopped the run (policy `stop`)
stopped.title: Stopped

PreflightRecord.title: PreflightRecord

Substitution.description: A kind with no route left, run on the first route that answered (`substitute`).
Substitution.title: Substitution

description:
`runs/<run>/run.json`: who drives the run (`pid`, `start_ticks`, `host_id`), which run
it is (`run_id`, `run_uid`), its run format, and what the run recorded about itself since.
`Run.update_info` may add fields of a caller's own.

format.description: the run format of the run directory; a run.json without it is of run format 1
format.title: Format

run_uid.description: the id no other run has, on any host; kept when the run is resumed
run_uid.title: Run Uid

host_id.description: the host that drives the run (`CONTRAAGENT_HOST_ID`, else the host name)
host_id.title: Host Id

start_ticks.description: the start of `pid` as the host's OS records it: on Linux clock ticks after boot (`/proc/<pid>/stat`), on macOS and Windows microseconds after the epoch; compared only for equality on this host, so a recycled pid is not taken for the run's process
start_ticks.title: Start Ticks

started_at.description: when the latest run start began
started_at.title: Started At

finished_at.description: when the run finished; absent while it runs or after it was killed
finished_at.title: Finished At

replay.description: the recordings directory a replay plays
replay.title: Replay

max_workers.description: how many tasks run at once
max_workers.title: Max Workers

quota_caps.description: by credential, the quota caps of each that has one
quota_caps.title: Quota Caps

quota_rule.description: the quota rule's `module.qualname`; empty without one
quota_rule.title: Quota Rule

flow.description: `module.qualname` of the run's top flow (`Pipeline.run(flow)`): the runs of one flow, which the monitor's forecast compares; absent in a run of an earlier release
flow.title: Flow

title: RunInfo
